create_CoefficientMapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
use_CoefficientMapping_coefficient_idx: use CoefficientMapping coefficient_idx to get tensor indices for coefficients up to a given degree and order
create_SO3_Grid: create an SO3_Grid module to transform between irreps and grid representations of spherical harmonics
use_SO3_Grid_to_grid: use SO3_Grid to_grid to convert an irreps embedding tensor into a 2D spherical grid representation
use_SO3_Grid_from_grid: use SO3_Grid from_grid to convert a 2D spherical grid tensor back into an irreps embedding
